h: Burna Boy and Asake feature in GTA 6 on African radio station AfroBank FM
p: Songs by Burna Boy and Asake are reportedly featured in Grand Theft Auto VI, which launches on 19 November. They are part of AfroBank FM, an in-game station dedicated to African sounds, with Burna Boy also a co-host.
body: Nigerian Afrobeats stars Burna Boy and Asake are reportedly among the artists whose music features in Grand Theft Auto VI, one of the most anticipated video games ever, which launches on Thursday, 19 November 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The two artists are part of AfroBank FM, a dedicated in-game radio station showcasing African sounds including amapiano, highlife and 3-step. Burna Boy is also said to co-host the station.
Tracks and previews of the station have been posted on Rockstar Games' official music pages, and clips have been circulating widely on social media.
Other Nigerian artists, including Seyi Vibez and Ayra Starr, have also drawn attention in connection with the game's soundtrack.

Publisher Rockstar Games said GTA 6 generated an estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide sales on its first day, which it called the biggest launch in entertainment history. That is nearly five times what GTA 5 made in its first 24 hours in 2013. The company also said the game sold 32.5 million units before release.
more: Burna Boy reportedly co-hosts the station.
